# Copy review ledger — what has ever been through a writer

**Generated, do not edit by hand.** `node scripts/export-copy-decks.mjs` rewrites this and every deck it reads.

The writing pass is **Cowork's**, not the PM's and not engineering's. The decks exist because the engineer is the weaker writer of the two and one artefact was wanted to hand to the stronger one. This ledger answers the only question that matters before commissioning a pass: which of these surfaces has ever had one.
